input.summary: Add a 60-day Customer non-renewal notice right to the auto-renewal sentence
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement renews automatically for 1-year terms and the only exit is ninety (90) days' notice, which exceeds our 60-day fallback window. We have added a Customer right to give sixty (60) days' notice of non-renewal, leaving the rest of paragraph 4(a) untouched.

ops.oldText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").
ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions or Customer gives sixty (60) days written notice of non-renewal (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").
